title: Chat agents: real status after an answer, stop closes the tab, cancelled questions, start errors
summary: A chat agent's tab now shows what the agent really does: the waiting dot clears after an answer, a withdrawn question loses its buttons, stopping closes the tab, and a failed start shows Claude Code's own error lines.

deferred.what: A background agent (PRD writer, PRD scorer, map tagging) whose Claude Code fails to start loses its error text: its tab vanishes while the member is elsewhere, the end note is discarded, and reopening shows only 'This agent is not running.'
deferred.why: Needs a decision on where a gone agent's failure surfaces (tab bar or app notice), outside this story's seam

deferred.what: When an agent leaves the agent list, its Open channel in the live session stays listed until a send to it fails
deferred.why: The session folder belonged to the parallel story issue #193
